evals.prompt: 帮我查一下 Google Antigravity CLI(agy)现在最新版本号是多少,有没有 Windows 版本。
evals.expected_output: Routes the lookup to Gemini (agy) with built-in search only, verifies the version claim itself, ends with a label line naming Gemini and an effort.

evals.prompt: 给 <SANDBOX>/quota.sh 加一个 --help 参数,打印一段用法说明然后退出 0。改完跑一下确认。
evals.expected_output: Routes to the coder lane (Sonnet) at low or medium effort, the file gains --help, it is run to confirm, review is skipped and the label line says so.

evals.prompt: 我想做一个脚本:每天早上 8 点把 ~/Downloads 里超过 30 天没动过的文件挪到 ~/Archive,挪完给我发一封邮件列出挪了哪些。先别写代码,告诉我应该怎么设计。
evals.expected_output: Routes to the planner lane (Opus) at high effort, returns a stepwise plan, notes that unattended scheduling plus email would trigger Codex review when implemented, ends with a label line.

evals.prompt: 帮我起草一段 200 字左右的中文产品简介,草稿就行,越省钱越好。
evals.expected_output: Setup: spick.json has a lane_registry with a cheap, chinese-tagged api-key lane whose prefer list has chinese and data text. Picks that lane for the draft (its prefer: matches the task), since the text carries no code; does not use deep for a cheap draft; ends with a label line naming the lane.

Setup: lane_registry declares a review-tagged lane with data text next to Codex (data code). The review sends source code, so the data:text lane is excluded; the review goes to a lane whose data is code, or is unset with the data-leak reminder noted, else to deep. Label line names the reviewer.

evals.prompt: 帮我看看 X 上最近关于 Claude Code 的讨论热度怎么样。
evals.expected_output: Setup: spick.json lanes.grok is false and no other enabled lane is tagged x-data. Says no lane is available for X data and what is needed (an enabled lane tagged x-data); does not substitute web search and does not call Grok.

evals.prompt: 用中转站那个 API 帮我把这个 200 行的脚本重构一下,代码你直接发过去就行。
evals.expected_output: Setup: lane_registry declares a relay lane tagged code with no data field (data:unset). The lane may receive what the user asked for, so the code is sent; the reply or label notes once that the Lanes line carries the third-party data-leak reminder; nothing is refused and no confirmation is demanded.
